question: Which current-image accessor composes base unit movement, and which exact predicates and cumulative lookups implement the retail movement UEAs 3, 12, and 55?

scope.boundary: This packet identifies the base movement byte, three retail UEA increments, bounded Jaguar/Impi hook facts inside the effective movement accessor, and the owner-observed Jaguar movement acceptance. It does not establish the gameplay meaning of the special return beyond Jaguar exclusion, name every pre-UEA modifier, UEA 29, the auxiliary signed halfword, every caller, movement-budget scaling, AI, save, scenario, multiplayer, or broader presentation and runtime behavior.

dependencies.use: Provides the accepted 0x82F700D8 unit-definition table, 0x94-byte records, and internal UnitType names.
Provides the accepted cumulative ActiveCivilizationBonusLookup contract and retail UEA placements.
Provides the separate ordinary movement-budget and command lifecycle boundary.

baseMovement.result: The accessor initializes retained movement composition from signed definition byte +0x42 before applying local modifiers and UEA increments.

ordinaryReturn.result: The ordinary return adds retained composed movement r26 to a signed auxiliary halfword. scenario-speedmode-movement-boundary.json#/result owns its conditional authored-field identity; broader movement-budget and game-pace meanings remain unproved.

specialReturn.result: One bounded special path adds constant r25 instead of composed movement r26.
specialReturn.qualification: The predicate and gameplay meaning of this override remain unresolved; the three UEA increments are therefore claimed for the ordinary composed return path, not every return.

retailUeaOwners.result: When definition flag 0x200 is set and cumulative UEA 3 is active, the accessor adds one to retained composed movement.

ueaIdArgument.flow: branches through 0x82CF2100 to the common lookup setup at 0x82CF2110

retailUeaOwners.result: When UnitType is 10 and cumulative UEA 12 is active, the accessor adds one to retained composed movement.

retailUeaOwners.effect: With cumulative UEA 55 active, the UnitType 6 path increases movement allowance by 1

ueaIdArgument.flow: falls through to the common lookup setup at 0x82CF2110

retailUeaOwners.result: When UnitType is 6 and cumulative UEA 55 is active, the accessor adds one to retained composed movement; this branch is not a claim that every Warrior-definition identity receives the effect.

inventoryCorrection.correctedClassification: literal request with merged common-call dataflow
inventoryCorrection.reason: The literal 12 at 0x82CF20FC branches to the shared setup and direct lookup call at 0x82CF2118 rather than appearing immediately beside the call instruction.

currentEvidence.method: One foreground read-only 65-word current-image query centered at 0x82CF2118, exact verification of 28 selected words and branch targets, and narrow generated-code corroboration of 0x82CF1F70 for base-field and input provenance.
currentEvidence.qualification: The static query performed no runtime action. Static evidence establishes the base byte, exact predicates, lookup dataflow, increments, and ordinary return composition; all other movement modifiers and consumers remain outside the packet. The separate owner-observed result is recorded in runtimeAcceptance.

warriorDefinition.result: The current-image Warrior definition has +0x50 bit 0 clear.

jaguarMovementHook.identity: Jaguar uses the Warrior definition / UnitType 6 movement contract
jaguarMovementHook.identityQualification: The title's semantic identity table maps Aztec plus Warrior to Jaguar Warrior; this is not a claim that the native guest identity selector was recovered for Jaguar.
jaguarMovementHook.specialReturn: The accepted current-image hook evidence excludes Jaguar from the special return.
jaguarMovementHook.ordinaryComposition: Jaguar remains on the ordinary composed path: signed definition +0x42, local modifiers, cumulative UEA lookup, and ordinary return composition at 0x82CF2194.
jaguarMovementHook.hookContract: The accepted current-image hook contract observes the ordinary EffectiveUnitMovementLookup result at 0x82CF1F70; it does not replace the accessor or establish a broader movement rule.

nativeImpiControl.result: Native Impi UEA 55 is the control for the UnitType 6 cumulative lookup and +1 increment path; it does not establish the same result for every Warrior-definition identity.

limits.runtime: The dated runtimeAcceptance records the bounded Jaguar result; complete runtime coverage and cadence remain unverified. Native Impi was a static reference, not a runtime-tested control.
limits.ai: No AI movement-parity claim is established.
limits.presentation: The owner observed the Jaguar's displayed movement in runtimeAcceptance; broader presentation coverage remains unverified.

runtimeAcceptance.method: Owner-observed enabled-mod test followed by disabling both Jaguar mods and restarting the title.
runtimeAcceptance.enabledResult: A newly created Jaguar displayed and spent one additional movement point relative to the native baseline.
runtimeAcceptance.disabledRestartResult: With both Jaguar mods disabled and the title restarted, a newly created Jaguar returned to native one movement.
runtimeAcceptance.qualification: This records the owner's bounded gameplay acceptance, not a captured runtime probe or an independent replay. It does not establish save/load persistence, AI parity, or runtime behavior for Impi and other identities.

guards: Do not infer that UEA 3 selects a single UnitType; the accepted predicate is definition flag 0x200.
Do not classify UEA 29 from the adjacent unresolved branch without an accepted effect contract.
Do not apply the three UEA increments to the unresolved special return path that bypasses r26.
Do not equate the effective movement stat directly with unit-record movement budget +0x02 or command path cost.
Do not claim complete AI, presentation, save, scenario, multiplayer, or runtime parity.
conclusion: EffectiveUnitMovementLookup at 0x82CF1F70 reads signed definition byte +0x42 and owns three retail movement UEAs on its ordinary composed return: UEA 3 adds one under definition flag 0x200, UEA 12 adds one for Riflemen UnitType 10, and UEA 55 adds one on the UnitType 6 branch when active. The current-image Warrior definition has +0x50 bit 0 clear, and accepted Jaguar hook evidence excludes Jaguar from the special return while native Impi UEA 55 supplies the static control case. UEA 12 reaches a merged common callsite. On 2026-09-05 the owner accepted one additional displayed and spendable Jaguar movement point, with native one movement restored after disabling both Jaguar mods and restarting. No broad Warrior-definition, AI, presentation, or complete runtime movement claim is made.
